sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A.
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 07.02.1992 passed by Sri S.C. Tyagi, IXth Additional District and Sessions Judge,
Aligarh in Criminal Appeal No. 81 of 1988, dismissing appeal and upholding the order of conviction and sentence of revisionist imposed by Sri Jai Veer Singh, Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offence),
Aligarh vide judgement and order dated 17.06.1988 in Case No. 25 of 1988, convicting revisionist under Sections 7/16(1)(A)(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, and sentencing to undergo one year rigorous imprisonment and also impose fine of Rs. 1000/- and
in case of non-payment of fine,
he shall further suffer three months rigorous imprisonment.
Being aggrieved, revisionist preferred present revision.
